tagline.en: A camera-controlled video world model built on Wan2.1, with geometry- and segmentation-aware conditioning.
tagline.zh: 基于 Wan2.1 构建的相机可控视频世界模型,带几何与分割感知的条件控制。

en: LiveWorld is a world model that generates video you can steer with a camera path. Beyond producing a clip, it lets you control how the viewpoint moves through a scene, which suits camera-controlled and video-to-video work.

It composes several models around the Wan2.1 text-to-video backbone: it draws on a vision-language model, a segmentation model, and geometry/depth components to condition generation on the scene's structure. In WorldFoundry it runs through a geometry-aware, monitor-centric inference route, taking your scene inputs and a camera trajectory to render the output.
zh: LiveWorld 是一个世界模型,可生成能用相机轨迹控制的视频。除了产出片段,它还允许你控制视角在场景中的移动方式,因而适合相机可控生成与视频到视频的任务。
它围绕 Wan2.1 文生视频骨干组合了多个模型:借助视觉语言模型、分割模型以及几何/深度组件,让生成以场景结构为条件。在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过一条几何感知、以监视视角为中心的推理路径运行,以你的场景输入与相机轨迹为条件渲染输出。

whenToUse.en: Reach for LiveWorld when you need camera-controlled video that respects scene geometry — steering the viewpoint through a structured scene rather than accepting the framing of a plain text-to-video model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要尊重场景几何的相机可控视频——在结构化场景中操控视角,而非被动接受纯文生视频模型的构图时,可以选择 LiveWorld。

notFor.en: It depends on several separate checkpoints (the Wan backbone plus vision, segmentation, and geometry components) that are staged locally rather than bundled, so plan for multiple downloads and disk space.
notFor.zh: 它依赖多个独立 checkpoint(Wan 骨干加上视觉、分割与几何组件),这些都需在本地准备而非随附,请为多次下载与磁盘空间做好准备。

en: Camera-controlled video you can steer with a viewpoint path
Built on the Wan2.1 backbone with geometry-aware conditioning
Combines vision-language, segmentation, and depth components
zh: 相机可控的视频,可用视角路径进行引导
基于 Wan2.1 骨干,带几何感知的条件控制
结合视觉语言、分割与深度组件
支持视频到视频与世界模型工作流
